root.name: Ruy Lopez: Classical Defense, Boden Variation
root.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bb5 Bc5 4. c3 Qe7

overview: Black plays 3...Bc5 and after 4.c3 the Boden idea 4...Qe7 prepares ...Nf6 and ...Bb6 with a flexible centre. White builds with 0-0, d4 or d3, and the bishop on b5 keeps the pin on Nc6 in play. Play is normal, open-ish and positional.

white_ideas.idea: Castle and play d4 to challenge the centre
Keep the bishop pair and the Bb5 pin

black_ideas.idea: Hold e5 and avoid getting pinned

typical_structures.structure: Open Spanish with pawn on e4 and e5
White c3-d4 centre against Black's e5

character.notes: Solid, with normal development and positional play.

structure.notes: Tension on e5/d4 centre; not locked.

approach.notes: Respectable but rarer than the Berlin or the Closed.

sublines_that_differ.name: Zaitsev Variation
sublines_that_differ.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bb5 Bc5 4. O-O Nd4 5. b4
sublines_that_differ.how: Sharper line where White grabs space with b4.

character.reason: Normal Spanish play, neither side forced.
